<figure class="mfm-architecture">

    <svg viewBox="-2 0 1084 807" role="img" aria-labelledby="river-arch-title river-arch-desc" focusable="false">
      <title id="river-arch-title">Marketing Foundational Model: shared transformer and graph-conditional flow</title>
      <desc id="river-arch-desc">Shared encoder, from bottom to top: treatments, covariates and observed outcomes enter as time by variables (values, time and observation masks), pass through a shared input embedding and a bi-attention block of causal time self-attention across time steps for each variable, variable self-attention across variables at each time step, and a feed-forward network, each with normalization and a residual addition, then a final normalization to encoded representations h over time, treatment and covariate. Graph-conditional flow, from bottom to top: flow inputs (state, flow time and trajectory noise, separate for each head) and h feed a joint graph flow over effects and graph structure (trajectory summaries and velocity field), which gives graph structure G; graph conditioning (graph-guided message passing and an effect support mask) also receives h and passes conditioned features and the support mask to the conditional flow decoder, which gives effects for a given graph: effects over time for base, treatment, covariate, latent and indirect components.</desc>
